topic: Someone receives flowers with no card attached
text: Those flowers weren't just plucked from some sunny meadow; they're a message. Wrapped up in ribbon and red petals, they came with whispers and shadows. I spun them around in my hands, letting the silence of the room amplify the unspoken. No card, no note, just the scent of something wilting before it could bloom. Every petal, a question. Every leaf, a veiled warning. I don’t deal in bouquets and sweet nothings, but this, this was a puzzle laid out on my desk, waiting for a mind sharp enough to unravel it. Darkness always has its whispers, and tonight, they sang through the stems. I don’t just see the flowers; I see the hands that picked them, the eyes that watched, the silence that followed. There’s a story here, and it’s waiting to be told.
